name: aisee-plugin
description: OpenSpec companion plugin focused on baseline migration, change authoring, and memory/knowledge guidance.

interface.shortDescription: OpenSpec companion for change authoring and engineering memory.
interface.longDescription: Aisee helps teams adopt OpenSpec, migrate existing-project baselines, clarify change intent, author detailed changes, and retrieve project memory and team knowledge guardrails.
defaultPrompt: aisee:init 审计 AGENTS.md、OpenSpec 项目配置和 Codex hooks
aisee:spec-migrate 为已有项目整理 baseline specs
aisee:change-author 细化当前 OpenSpec change 内容
